text:
Amelia CSM: Theta Inc submitted a formal request to onboard a 14B legal summarizer (model id: theta-legal-14b). They need PHI/PII-safe handling, HSM for keys, and a security review before we enable production. They also asked about timelines — they want a pilot in 3 weeks.

Amelia CSM: Key asks from Theta: HSM integration, data residency in us-west-2, eval run on their 5k doc testset, contract renewal in Aug 2026 (potential upsell to Dedicated). Raising cause this affects renewal conversation.

Sam Solutions: Looping in infra/eng ops — do we have a prebuilt HSM flow for Dedicated or is this Private-only? Also need expected qps and latency SLOs from Theta.

Li Safety: We need to run these safety checks before any prod traffic:
- PII/PHI extraction tests
- Hallucination rate on legal Q&A sets
- Instruction-following and redaction tests
I can author a short eval bench if they share a subset. Suggest label: `theta-legal-safety-v1`.

Evan ML: Quick ML questions — is this a finetuned checkpoint (base + RLHF/ft)? What format are weights in (gguf/pt)? Quantization profile preferred? If pt/torch we can do 4-bit quant on Dedicated but need to know weight layout.

Priya Eng: From a serving perspective we should plan: canary -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic fallback to `redwood-legal-7b` on elevated latency/errors. Also recommend prefix KV caching for repeated doc contexts. What traffic are they expecting (rps)?

Amelia CSM: Theta answered in email: they expect 30 rps peak, avg 8 rps; model is finetuned (PT), weights available; dataset is internal legal docs, no external sharing. They requested HSM + audit logs and retention policy of 90 days for traces.

Natasha AM: Flagging renewal risk — Theta is a mid-market account with annual renewal Aug 2026. If onboarding stalls on security/HSM we may lose momentum. Recommend prioritizing security review and a short enablement session for their infra team (2-3 days).

Sam Solutions: Ops note — create ticket for HSM onboarding and security checklist. We need L1: SOC docs, L2: architecture diagram from Theta, L3: keys rotation plan.

OpsBot: Ticket created: REDWOOD-ONBOARD-6421 — HSM + security review for Theta Inc. Link: https://redwood.example/tickets/REDWOOD-ONBOARD-6421 :white_check_mark:

Li Safety: I'll draft the eval checklist. Quick ask for CSM: can Theta share 200 de-identified docs as a holdout for safety tests? If they can't, we'll create synthetic prompts to approximate.

Evan ML: Also need a sample inference config. Theta provided this snippet:
```
model: theta-legal-14b
format: pt
quant: none (initial)
batch_size: 4
max_tokens: 512
```

Priya Eng: OK — plan for rollout: create canary on Dedicated with HSM-proxy, run safety/evals in staging, then enable traffic ramp. I'll pair with infra for routing rules.

Natasha AM: I'll book an enablement call with Theta (AM + infra + security) for next Tue 10am PT. If we get greenlight by end of next week, we can hit their 3-week pilot ask.

Amelia CSM: Thanks all. Action items: Li to provide eval checklist, Sam to gather HSM flow docs, Priya to draft rollout steps, Natasha to run enablement call. I'll update the account health note and tag renewal as "watch" until HSM cleared. :thumbsup:
